Added effective-dated tax rates and tax configuration resolution
Added separate EFRIS configuration, fiscal documents and fiscalization event queue
Added forced tenant RLS and financial permissions

Added tenant-scoped analytics permissions and forced RLS projections
Added migration 021 phase5 analytics foundation
Removed user-facing Business Engine route module
Retired open-development browser session bootstrap

Added Redis-backed authentication rate limits
Added fail-closed production configuration checks
Applied lexа_app role per transaction for PgBouncer-safe RLS enforcement
Added bounded SQLAlchemy pooling and PostgreSQL statement/lock/idle transaction timeouts
Added migration 022 for the live Brain foundation schema
Added CI and direct Neon backup automation
separate login-enabled lexa_runtime role inheriting NOLOGIN lexa_app

health readiness logs sanitized production-safe DB diagnostics
removed internal Business Engine and Kernel frontend routes
pinned web dependency versions
introduced shared authenticated workspace convergence across Home, Commerce, Finance, Reports and Compliance
deepened Products with variant lifecycle, SKU identity, pricing and barcode workflows
deepened Inventory with adjustment, count, transfer and location operations
added route-level loading and error boundaries for core Catalog and Inventory workspaces
added idempotency and audit/event persistence to warehouse and location creation
separated signed-out authentication failures from temporary API availability failures
updated frontend contract tests for the v2.8 workspace architecture
added global workspace search/command surface with Ctrl/Meta+K navigation
added explicit loading placeholders so unavailable or pending business data is never shown as fabricated zero state
added idempotent variant update, barcode creation, price-list creation and price creation contracts
added Phase 3.5 workspace convergence and inventory operations implementation contract
Replaced the orphaned invitation-acceptance UI with a safe unavailable state because the backend has no invitation endpoint; added a regression contract and clarified the Vercel apps/web root.
Added an explicit, safety-bounded cleanup script for obsolete user-facing Business Engine/Kernel web routes and the generated TypeScript build cache.

Phase 0: allow cookie-only refresh requests, use single-flight browser refresh, restore sessions before protected reads, gate workspace UI until session verification, and show unavailable dashboard values on failed reads.
Standardized Next.js build command in apps/web/vercel.json and included a ZIP deletion manifest for obsolete frontend-only routes so the repository ZIP extractor removes them from existing checkouts.
Added SECURITY DEFINER refresh-token hash lookup so cookie refresh can establish tenant RLS context safely
Added authoritative /api/v1/auth/me identity, workspace, membership, role and permission endpoint
Set both app.tenant_id and app.user_id for protected database requests
Added additive migration 028 to harden empty RLS context and backfill least-privilege roles for roleless active memberships
Added correlated server-side tracebacks and request-id-preserving Vercel proxy behavior
Preserved multiple Set-Cookie headers through the Vercel API proxy
Session restoration verifies current identity before unlocking business modules
Logout uses the same tenant-safe lookup; stale concurrent refresh-token rotations are rejected
Audited canonical Neon branch and confirmed migration 028 and the auth refresh lookup function are absent from the live ledger/schema at audit time
Readiness now verifies the auth migration, security-definer refresh lookup function, lexa_app execute privilege, and RLS-bypassing function owner
Hardened the 12 observed raw tenant-context RLS policies to use NULLIF on empty transaction-local tenant settings
Updated stale frontend/backend regression contracts and added auth-schema readiness contract checks
Added end-to-end forensic audit with production rollout gates and explicit unverified-deployment limitations
Promoted migration 028 to canonical Neon lexa-live after explicit approval; validated lookup function, grant, SECURITY DEFINER owner and hardened RLS predicates after promotion
Used the confirmed Render My Workspace LEXA service logs to identify the exact missing-function cause for auth refresh HTTP 500
Updated forensic report and manual rollout notes with production verification and outstanding deployment drift
Corrected migration 022 dynamic Brain RLS policy identifier construction and empty tenant-context SQL quoting
Added dated canonical Neon migration ledger snapshot and explicit manifest for seven unavailable historical migration sources
Added migration source reconciliation checker with strict release-gate mode
Corrected deployment guide to distinguish /health liveness from /ready dependency readiness
Expanded packaged GitHub Actions checks to run both frontend contract suites and enforce strict migration replay readiness
Recovered migration 019_phase4a_customer_credit_allocation byte-for-byte from its historical GitHub commit and verified its Git blob SHA
Generated and included apps/web/package-lock.json; CI now uses npm ci for deterministic frontend install
Aligned Render blueprint service name with existing LEXA service; kept /ready as readiness health check
Verified public Render liveness/readiness and Vercel login endpoints using read-only HTTP probes; observed live readiness remains on older database-only payload
Updated source-gap manifest from eight to seven unrecovered applied migrations without inventing SQL
Fixed Brain RLS dynamic policy SQL with PostgreSQL format identifier/literal quoting and validated it on disposable Neon branch lexa-convergence-test-2026-10-08
Re-queried canonical Neon migration ledger on 2026-10-15 and verified migration 028 plus refresh lookup function/grant/owner properties read-only
Added 2026-10-15 canonical migration ledger snapshot, retaining 2026-10-13 snapshot for historical comparison
Added Phase 0 anonymous/credentialed HTTP acceptance runner for refresh-cookie rotation, /auth/me, protected catalog reads, logout and revocation
Added deletion-manifest applier and listed obsolete unregistered API business_engine route module for checkout cleanup
Scoped pytest collection to canonical tests and separated strict migration replay into a manual release gate
Retried GitHub branch creation on 2026-10-15; integration still returns HTTP 403 and no code was pushed
Live Render 2026-10-15: /health 200, /ready 200 but database-only readiness payload, first bodyless refresh probe timed out before a warmed retry returned 401, anonymous logout 200
Phase 1: centralize transaction-local application-role switching for ORM and direct readiness connections
Phase 1: validate DATABASE_LOGIN_ROLE against pooled Neon DATABASE_URL username and require TLS
Phase 1: add guarded migration 029 for a separate non-inheriting lexa_runtime_safe login with SET-only membership in lexa_app
Phase 1: add runtime-role security regression tests and scripts/verify-phase1.sh
Phase 1: document isolated Neon test-branch validation and gated production rollout procedure
Phase 5 Increment 01: multi-line sales cart, checkout idempotency key, branch-scoped sales history, sale detail and print view.
Phase 5 Increment 02: cumulative refund cap evaluated against original collections minus all recorded prior refunds while locking the source sale.
Phase 5 Increment 02: branch-scoped returns list and payment/return/refund ledger details on sale detail.

Phase 5 Increment 02: staging-only Playwright cases for split tender, partial payment, idempotent retry, stock ledger read-after-write, cumulative refund limit, cashier permission denial, manager positive price/discount, and optional cross-branch denial.

Phase 5 final gate review (2026-10-21): pinned GitHub revision d228e6467894857aeeb632a189d10680179404db; Vercel Node 24.x production build is ready, while the same-commit Render startup failed because workspace/membership routes import a missing shared refresh-cookie helper.

Added a shared HttpOnly refresh-cookie helper to apps/api/app/auth.py and aligned apps/api/app/routes/auth.py to use it; this is a local source repair and is not committed/deployed because the GitHub integration returned HTTP 403.
Updated cookie hardening regression contract and added a source-level shared-cookie import regression test.

Phase 5 Increment 03: compute cumulative refund allowance from gross recorded payment allocations minus every prior recorded refund; do not subtract earlier refunds twice from the already-net sale.amount_paid value.
Phase 5 Increment 03: recompute sale paid/due values from the payment, refund and customer-credit ledgers; refund-table mutations refresh their source sale through an AFTER trigger.
Phase 5 Increment 03: partial returns prorate line total, discount and tax by returned quantity rather than reusing full-line adjustments.

Phase 5 Increment 03: no-refund returns are bounded by the customer open receivable in both the API and accounting-journal function; choose refund/customer-credit settlement when the receivable is insufficient.
Phase 5 Increment 03: post idempotent sale-return settlement journal entries, returned-inventory COGS reversals and a pending EFRIS CREDIT_NOTE only for active registered tenants.
Phase 5 Increment 03: add dedicated 2210 customer store-credit liability mapping; distinguish issued credit from amounts allocated to a particular receivable.
Phase 5 Increment 03: analytics credit/outstanding values read the authoritative sales.amount_due value instead of independently recalculating and drifting after refunds/returns.
Phase 5 Increment 03: sale details and return list surface associated accounting-journal and fiscal-document states in the frontend.

Added migration 033 for cumulative refund settlement, refund ledger synchronization and authoritative analytics balances; migration 034 for return settlement/COGS journals, customer-credit liability and optional EFRIS credit notes; migration 035 for the no-refund/open-receivable invariant.
Added Phase 5 rule tests, source-contract tests and migration-contract tests; authenticated Playwright test runner remains fail-closed and requires explicit staging-only opt-in.

Repaired malformed Phase 5 analytics migration source by adding an explicit non-historical repair-candidate header, removing non-SQL trailer content and using sales.amount_due for the outstanding-balance projections; canonical byte parity is not claimed.
description: LEXA consolidated source candidate with the Phase 5 checkout, return/refund settlement, accounting, stock-ledger and EFRIS credit-note integrations.
